body: Current state, 2026-08-30: D1-D10 movie architecture consensus is durable and landed on main by merge ef005e43a1b5b7b02824bfe084b7c3aef63c1402. Canonical plan: docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md, 669 lines, SHA-256 b12f79ceb61e020cd02c43c631ed015a9034d9c3b9c597da726337425a21e748. Settled design: one shared narrative model; raw evidence -> persistent modality observations/features -> joined proposals and critic findings -> deterministic resolver -> validated shared graph; exact typed clocks, rendition and identity; timed language lattice; providers propose only; SourceFrozen construction; predeclared transcript/visual/audio/full/one-shot contrasts; renderer-neutral StoryAtlas packets; fully automatic with typed unresolved, unsupported, failed, partial, and alternative outcomes. The component-admission ledger is frozen as cand-7MEX4N9K5PVNQS7C32XCWVNX3H at f203b783da349d705258fef8634becf3e1e5a554 over current main 0b414b443e62cf4ee67a7f81e4846c2a8c13ab36, one added path, artifact SHA-256 eb3caa998a7f64bfb2779b222632fffabd3c11343da7983c64bc1677067d4739. Both required reviewers formally approve; chief authorization is the sole landability blocker. This ledger is documentation only and keeps the first acquisition court held. P1 now has an amended Baseball Diagnostic proposal at post-01M1990XS5MDR2N3GWXPYKQKR2: participant-by-eligible-situation accessibility plus overlapping typed compression/blending/revisit estimands; explicit START dependencies and separate CLOSURE gates; Development/Calibration freeze before UntouchedTest; aggregate-only evidence and null-result publication. It still needs team confirmation and chief promotion to an integration bead. Independent B0 remains open on the owner-action list and first-court evidence. No exact source-film plus human-recall pair is admitted. No C1 movie runtime, source/media/participant acquisition, package/model install, terms acceptance, API migration, or StoryAtlas implementation is authorized until P1 and B0 both close.
